lead_sentence: Skyclause reads the rain gauge, the haze index and the stadium listings around Bukit Jalil, and makes one approved, graded call for each class, event or commute window.

strip_help: Drag to select a window. Arrow keys move it by 15 minutes, Page keys by an hour, Home and End to the ends of the day. Shift with arrow keys changes the length.
time_error: Type a time on the quarter hour, such as 15:30 MYT, 1530 or 3.30pm.
